about.headline: Bridging Vision, Design, and Engineering
about.body: Hi, I’m Hamdani Harfan—a multidisciplinary Designer, Software Engineer, and banking professional currently contributing at PT Bank Mandiri. I operate at the intersection of enterprise-grade reliability, creative problem-solving, and technical execution, transforming complex requirements into seamless, user-centric applications. My expertise spans end-to-end product development: from conceptualizing intuitive UI/UX designs and feature specifications to engineering reliable architectures and managing Google Play Console deployment lifecycles. Whether managing financial systems at PT Bank Mandiri or building tools like D-Fin, Dagangku AI, DScan, DStudio, DicteDoc, DTS, and DNotes, my goal is delivering polished digital experiences that solve real-world problems efficiently.
